definitions.explanation: The fourth month of the year. In Japan, April marks the beginning of the school year and fiscal year.

examples.japanese: {四月|しがつ}は{桜|さくら}がきれいです。
examples.english: Cherry blossoms are beautiful in April.

examples.japanese: {四月|しがつ}から{学校|がっこう}が{始|はじ}まります。
{四月|しがつ}に{友|とも}だちと{花見|はなみ}に{行|い}きました。
examples.english: I went cherry blossom viewing with friends in April.

examples.japanese: {四月|しがつ}は{暖|あたた}かくて、{外|そと}で{遊|あそ}ぶのが{気持|きも}ちいいですね。
examples.english: April is warm, and it's pleasant to play outside, isn't it?

notes: April uses し (4) not よん. This is one of the months where the number reading changes: 四 is read し, not よん. April is when new employees join companies and students start new schools, making it a season of beginnings in Japan.
